historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; captures a decoded data-width line without device identity, FFFFh handling or total-width comparison.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds per-device width/ECC correlation and unknown policy but lowers capability for pending inputs.

original_test_intent: Verify that each Type 17 Data Width reports the approved number of usable data bits for the identified memory device, correctly uses FFFFh for Unknown, does not exceed known Total Width and remains correct after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw Type 17 records, identify each device/socket and population state, decode raw Data Width and Total Width including FFFFh, compare usable width and any check-bit difference with the approved module organization and trusted evidence, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the usable-width/module baseline and reboot plan. No DIMM or ECC-setting action is required.
required_inputs: Expected usable Data Width by device class or locator
Expected Total Width and check-bit relationship
Policy for FFFFh Unknown and empty Type 17 records
Stable identity and optional trusted SPD mapping
Validated parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS, OS/EDAC and approved SPD queries; do not alter DIMMs or ECC settings.
Interpret raw FFFFh as Unknown, never as a numeric bit width.
When both fields are known, require Data Width not greater than Total Width and preserve the difference.
Do not derive usable width solely from OS total memory capacity.
Stop on identity ambiguity, impossible width relationship or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Decode per-device data/total widths, validate sentinel and ordering rules, compare approved module organization and pre/post reboot state.
Do not modify memory, infer undocumented organization or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve per-device data width, total/check-bit relationship and Unknown/empty-record policy.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Data Width value is relevant, but grep -A1 loses record identity, raw FFFFh and often the paired Total Width needed to judge it.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 17 data; report handle/locator/population, raw and decoded Data Width/Total Width, their relation and module/SPD comparison.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Data Width scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and hardware/ECC changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate raw Data Width with Total Width for every stable Type 17 identity, handle FFFFh and empty records explicitly, compare the approved module organization and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser and optional SPD-tool versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Data Width/Total Width definitions and authoritative module/platform organization.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds device identity, raw sentinel handling, companion-field constraints and module-organization evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects Unknown misdecoding, data-greater-than-total defects, wrong usable width and cross-socket attribution errors.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Per-device data-width/module baseline and sentinel policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A correct Data Width is descriptive firmware inventory and does not prove runtime data-lane integrity.

project_override_considerations: A project may contain mixed memory organizations, but expected Data Width must be keyed to locator/device class; applying a single 64-bit value to every record is not acceptable without topology evidence.
expected_evidence: Approved platform/device identities, data/total-width baseline and Unknown policy
Per-device raw/decoded widths, ordering/difference result and empty/populated context
Optional trusted SPD/EDAC correlation identified to the same device
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot semantic width comparison

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Data Width has defined bit and Unknown semantics and complements Total Width.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Raw decoding and paired-field validation are fully automatable after approved baselines.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds identity, raw FFFFh, Total Width constraint and device-organization correlation.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains safe read-only checks while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates structural usable-width evidence from runtime lane qualification and engineer verdict.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible 64-bit string from passing when it is tied to the wrong socket, encoded Unknown or incompatible with Total Width/module design.
independent_technical_reasoning: Raw width values, identities and constraints are finite structured data and are deterministically software-checkable once the project baseline is supplied.
